value.rationale: The cubic Hankel determinant is the first square Hankel singular hypersurface with a rank-one singular cone; thickened local determinant counts cannot be deduced from the usual field singularity probability. The exact all-depth arithmetic zeta, ramification-universal strata and valuation tails are natural invariants, and its relation to the known topological specialization supplies additional structural motivation.
